Warranty Expiry Tracker

Track product warranties: purchase date + warranty length gives expiry dates and days left, with expired and expiring-soon alerts.

Warranties

ProductPurchasedWarrantyExpiresStatus

📖 How to use

  1. Add each product with its purchase date and warranty length.
  2. The list shows the expiry date and days remaining, sorted by urgency.
  3. Expired items show red, expiring within 90 days amber.
  4. Everything is saved in your browser automatically.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the expiry date computed?

Purchase date + warranty length (in months or years), using calendar months — e.g. 12 months from 2026-10-01 is 2027-10-01.

Where is my data stored?

In your browser's localStorage, namespaced to this tool — it stays on this device.

Does it remind me automatically?

No background notifications — but expiring-soon items are highlighted amber so a quick weekly check is enough.
